answer: Two jurors who land more than one point apart on the same answer pull a third panel, and the minority posts collateral that is slashed when that panel calls it wrong. Because a clone ring must keep every member consistent under that re-check, one grader with nothing to gain breaks the block, so a 30-clone farm grading a fixed text drops 30 bonds at the first split, and an opal bond costs 200 POA each, more than the onyx-tier payout a cloned seat can earn on the reef.
